Subject: Next steps & demo scheduling – Acme Inc.

Hi Emily / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today – really helpful to understand Acme's goals around improving search relevance and reducing embedding costs. Quick recap from our side:

- Current pain: slow re-ranking pipeline for customer-facing search, high per-request embedding costs for nightly batch jobs.
- Key success metrics: 30% reduction in average query latency, 40% reduction in embedding cost per million rows, and no regression on quality (NDCG).

Next step: we'd love to schedule a 45-minute technical deep dive / demo where we show: architecture for low-latency reranking, batching & caching patterns, and a short walkthrough of the Redwood Console (observability + rollout controls).

Proposed times (all PST):
- Tue Dec 1, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Dec 2, 2:00–2:45pm

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your team will join (engineering + platform/security)? If neither works, send a couple times that do and we'll adapt.

If helpful I can send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and attach a short agenda.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
